shin_fairing.status: RESTRICTED (Thermal 26412c7 / D69): the shank from the tibia collar to the knee must stay uncovered. Only the knee-region cap (knee_cap) remains; this hull is kept for reference.

ankle_boot.note: flexible TPU-nylon boot over rod ends / instep lugs; z<=170 in shank frame; excludes the foot box

knee_cap.note: shank-side knee lever + rod ends swept 0-135 in the thigh frame; cap (shank-mounted) must stay outside the thigh fairing and inside this keep-out complement

foot_upper.note: upper shell over the 240x100x18 box; sole contact patch unchanged

knee_saddle.desc: 6061 finned clamp-on saddle (knee heat spreader + knee drive mount)
knee_saddle.fins: 10 axial, 95x20x1.5-2, rear/side sector x<=14+..., none at x>36.5 (ankle screw bodies swept x>=45.6 at z320-400, >=39.4 at z400-420)
knee_saddle.free_air: required (no cover, exhaust must not wash the tibia collar)

lower_shank.desc: bare tibia, uncovered per Thermal; the ankle boot top stays at z<=170

knee_cap_vs_thigh_gap.note: between the two hull+5 keep-outs (hardware-to-hardware ~20 mm); 22 mm from 0 to 105 deg, set by the thigh fairing lower edge z555. D69 ø85 housing (+4.5 mm radial) -> ~5.7 mm keep-out gap / ~15.7 hardware [EST, no re-CAD]
